A LITTLE NOTE FOR YOU

💌 A Letter for Ayesha

Dear Ayesha, my Tomato Pandu 🍅

On your birthday, I just want you to know how special you are. You have a beautiful way of making ordinary moments feel a little brighter, and I hope this new chapter brings you peace, happiness, and countless reasons to smile.

May your dreams keep growing, your worries become lighter, and every new day bring you closer to the life you imagine. Always remember how capable, loved, and valued you are. Keep shining in your own way, and never lose that lovely smile.

May this year meet you with kindness, good people, and memories you'll want to keep forever. You deserve every beautiful thing coming your way.

With love, always ♡
